full_judgment: 47. In driving home the offence to the gateway of convict-appellants prosecution put reliance upon Medico Legal Examination Report, Exhibit 4. PW 10 Dr Kamuda Prosad Saha examined PW 2 Runa Laila on 7-6-1999 at 2-00 PM. On examination he issued certificate on 11-7-1999. Certificate was issued after a period of 34 days of examination of PW 2 Runa Laila. In the Certificate, PW 10 recorded opinion that victim had forceful sexual intercourse and age of victim Runa Laila is 18/19 years. Doctor PW 10 on witness dock admitted that he submitted a report after a period of long 34 days. He, also, stated that the victim was not referred to him by any Doctor nor by any clinic. He found some interpolation in the Report. Of course, he denied defence suggestion that being influenced by Tadbirkar of the case he laid a Report. Medico Legal Examination Report was required to be laid, immediately after examination of PW 2 Runa Liala. Submission of Report by Doctor PW 10 after a period of long 34 days of the examination of PW 2 has been put to a doubt in respect of veracity and righteousness of Medico Legal Examination Report and that report was not at all required to be relied upon by the Tribunal in resting its decision in awarding conviction and sentence upon convict-appellants.
